selection_correction.evidence: face_check.mask explicitly states ct > 0 (sheet mask under 5 %)
selection_correction.withdrawn_inference: Using sheet_fraction=1.0 as superior sheet coverage over the other two candidates.
selection_correction.pending: The exact metric code and effects on previous choices require a separate study.
selection_correction.historical_selection_preserved: selection.json records the actual pre-download choice; it is not rewritten after inspection.

visual_review.coverage: Six distinct spatial tiles; portions of all seven models in both orders. Numerical verification is broader than visual inspection.
observations: CT has curved layered contours and wide dark channels. A single central slice does not establish a segmentation error.
Selected Hecate blobs are isolated or irregular; Reader maps are diffuse; no distinctive stroke sequence is selected.
Seed42 and seed43 show broad responses near borders and dark CT bands; d9v2 contains texture resembling the underlying CT contours.
Agreement of some bright areas is not evidence of ink or legible text.
visual_review.decision: No follow-up ROI selected. This does not establish absent ink or a negative result for the scroll.

limitations: Physical sheet identity and exact XYZ mapping were not verified.
Training exposure and complete prior reading history are unknown.
Published predictions are prior work, not our discovery.
